play.title: Canari - Mines Saint-Étienne
play.shortDescription: The Marteaux network: student life, associations and encrypted chat
play.fullDescription:
Canari is an independent application developed by the Les Rootz student association for all the students of École des Mines de Saint-Étienne (EMSE). It is not published by the school's administration.

Canari brings the student life of EMSE together in one place, and its conversations are end-to-end encrypted:

• Associations: browse the directory, discover their members and news, follow an association or a person and set the bell for their notifications. Officers generate the carte de la vie asso.
• Membership dues and shop: associations run registration forms with online or cash payment, manage membership dues and have a shop.
• Feed, polls and reposts: three tabs (Associations, For you, Campus) to follow posts from associations and people, vote, react, comment and repost.
• CanaReels: film and watch short videos, and send a post or a CanaReel into a conversation.
• Lives: watch or broadcast a live with its chat and reactions.
• Agenda: a calendar adapted to your campus and your programme, with "Campus" events, an ICS subscription or a PDF export to take it into your own calendar.
• Bookings and forms: book a room or a venue from a schedule, build forms and answer those of the associations.
• Communities: find your class, your campus or your association in discussion spaces organised in channels.
• Encrypted messaging: chat one-on-one or in groups with end-to-end encryption (MLS protocol). Messages can only be read by the people in the conversation.
• Audio and video calls: call one person, and the phone rings even when the app is closed or the phone is locked.
• Photos, videos and documents: share files that are encrypted before they are even sent.
• Guided tour: on first launch, a walk-through to find your way around.

An EMSE account is required to sign in.
